description: This file defines a simple logging utility with different log levels, a Logger struct for logging messages, and an extension to initialize LogLevel from a string configuration value.

methods.name: rank
methods.description: Returns the numeric rank associated with each log level, used for comparison.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at the specified log level if it meets the current logging level.

methods.name: init?(configValue:)
methods.description: Initializer for LogLevel from a string config value, case-insensitive.
